summary: RelayState truncation in eu-west proxy removes org claim causing successful login with no RBAC for Model Insights
description: Issue summary: Several employees in eu-west can authenticate via Okta SAML and arrive at Model Insights (internal console) but their session contains no org or role claims, resulting in UI showing "No Access". Impact: Affected users (approx 12 reported so far) cannot access runbooks and dashboards; blocks oncall and support flows for eu-west teams. Observed behaviour: SAML response accepted, session cookie issued, but RBAC service returns 403 because org claim is missing. The IdP assertion contains the correct org claim upstream of the proxy. Hypothesis: RelayState or SAML response is being truncated/rewritten by the edge proxy in eu-west which strips appended claim metadata used by our claim-transformer, causing role mapping to fail. This ticket tracks investigation, mitigation, and fix deployment.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) From an eu-west client, initiate SSO to Model Insights via https://insights.redwood.internal (eu-west edge).
2) Complete Okta SAML flow using user with org membership (e.g., alice@acme.com).
3) Observe redirect back to /auth/callback and successful 200 from console but UI shows "No Access" and RBAC API returns 403 for /api/v1/roles lookup.
4) Capture SAML response and RelayState before and after edge-proxy to check for truncation/rewrites.
logs: edge-proxy (eu-west) request-id=px-9f3a: RelayState length=1024 -> forwarded length=640
idp (okta) saml-request-id=AR_1a2b3c: Assertion includes attribute org: 'acme'
rbac-service trace-id=rb-77c: role lookup failed: missing claim 'org' -> returning 403
console auth callback session_id=hs-44: created session with claims: [sub, email] (org missing)
comments: 2026-03-10 09:18 - Support (Eileen Chen): Customer/internal report came via #support-eu Slack. Users authenticate but UI shows "No Access". Collected sample SAML XML from user session and initial headers from client.

2026-03-10 10:02 - Identity Eng (Priya Rao): Noted RelayState appearing shorter in proxy logs. Requested packet capture and full headers from affected user. Added early hypothesis that proxy's query-string buffer limit may be truncating RelayState appended metadata.

2026-03-10 13:45 - Edge Eng (Marco Silva): Found a recent config change on eu-west edge added a request header sanitizer to drop long query params above 700 bytes (rollout 2026-03-08). Rolling back sanitizer to test impact.
2026-03-11 08:12 - Support (Eileen Chen): After rollback test, two previously blocked users report access restored. Confirmed role mapping returns valid roles when full RelayState is preserved.

2026-03-12 15:30 - Identity Eng (Priya Rao): Patch to proxy applied to respect RelayState up to 2kb for SAML endpoints; hotfix rolled to eu-west edge. Follow-up ticket created for audit and hardening (INT-233500).
resolution: Workaround: rolled back proxy sanitizer and temporarily increased accepted RelayState length; Permanent fix: proxy change to preserve RelayState for SAML endpoints deployed to eu-west on 2026-03-12. Follow-up: add automated tests and telemetry for RelayState size and assertion claim presence (tracked INT-233500).
